goal: Share team files through selected review, notifications and revocable download access.

requirements.text: Seeded local accounts can log in and log out; no registration. Passwords are not captured.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: An authenticated member uploads a private file owned by that member.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: The file owner selects another existing member as recipient and an existing member as reviewer, creating a pending share.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: Only the selected reviewer may approve or reject a pending share. Approval grants recipient access; rejection does not.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: Review results go to owner, selected reviewer, and recipient. Approval also sends a separate sharing message to all three. Users read only their own notifications.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: Recipients see and download only currently approved shares. Pending, rejected, cancelled, and revoked shares confer no access. Every new download checks current authority.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: Only the owner can cancel a pending share. A cancelled request cannot subsequently be approved.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: Only the owner can revoke an approved share; new downloads using old URLs or unchanged pages are denied immediately. Local downloaded copies are not recovered.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: SQLite with SQLAlchemy persists records; file content remains inside the trial data directory. State and resulting messages commit together.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance

requirements.text: Drive mode executes the confirmed declaration; maintain public graph, source mappings, database observations, real lifecycles and evidence independently of business authority.
requirements.source: review/design-dialogue.md U001-U006; trial answers, not production acceptance
